notes.title: Said the bug truth tried my best to make an update!
notes.notes:
You can now go to the 3rd floor of Kuncheng.
Deranged Kun Demon added the ability "Get close to melt quickly" instead of "Kun Poison Burst"
Weakened weapon skills: Mamba Iron Elbow attack damage bonus 200% → 180%, TP cost 18→20.
Enhanced Weapon Skills: Blitz Polish Magic Attack Bonus 130%→135%
Enhanced Weapon Skills: Strafe Attack Damage Bonus 75%→83%
Fixed a bug in the prologue plot where the coffin shop came with the artifact "Subject 3 Light".
The number of times "Dimensional Slash" can be used is limited to 1→2, the attack damage of "Wind Slash" is increased by 40% →44%, and "Stealth" is reworked: The self enters the invisibility state for 1 turn. Heals 33% of Attack HP (Critical Hit) and gains 6TP.
🤓☝🏼 Because the minter did not find out before, Happy Chestnut Cat can use Super Happy Heal twice in a row when the number of actions is +1, resulting in Happy Chestnut Cat's milk volume being too explosive. So Happy Cat ushered in a simple and crude update: Happy Chestnut Cat in the Hapyy state cannot gain the +1 status of Actions.

notes.title: Said the bug truth of staying up late to update
notes.notes:
Changed the mana exhaustion skill range of the 2nd floor boss Chaos Kun Demon to all, changed the amount of blue drawn from 25 to 35, and increased the frequency of mana exhaustion skill release (the maximum mana and the mana required to release too beautiful are still 150).
Reduced "It's Too Beautiful" magic attack bonus by 133% → 100%
Fixed a bug where the return port point did not pop up when clearing the first floor of Kuncheng.
Weakened: Plastic Chair Base Defense & Magical Defense 60→48, HP 480→420, Agility 0→10, no longer immune to Poison, Poison, Burn, Frostbite, Curse

notes.title: A small update, you can go to town tomorrow
